label: vs_rho shape: root-finding vs inherited-F4 decomposition on public targets, E_0 m=13, d=5
description: Head-to-head of pdp3-koblitz:engine=rootfind (DecompositionStrategy::PairTable) and #1333's inherited-F4 Groebner engine on the koblitz-standard-subspace base the F6-IC ladder used (research/f6_ic_ecbench_ladder_20261005), at m = 3 (the ladder's summand count) and m = 2 (the root-finding note's), on eight public one-target workloads with the strong signed-Frobenius rho as the reference and the plain signed-Frobenius rho as the operations baseline. Each workload is one target; ecbench claim build takes one IC run and one strong-rho run of it. The root finder's S is a complete count of group additions; the Groebner arms' S is a lower bound (Boolean word XORs counted, not charged), so the two engines are compared on the resource vector and wall time, never by dividing one S by the other. A constant-factor engineering comparison of the decomposition step on synthetic known-answer curves; no security claim.
